question: Under the adopted native-full63 test-fluid contract, derive source-owned Compton temperature coupling, its complete analytic last-row derivatives, and the exact frozen-coefficient temperature relaxation without changing the inherited number or radiation-energy operators.

hypotheses.prediction: The actual-hot log-temperature contribution is independent of logT at fixed composition and geometry; its complete state derivative includes the current E_gamma0 and log-H terms.
hypotheses.falsifier: Nonzero symbolic residual of the proposed derivative or a contradictory leading-order primary-source coefficient.

hypotheses.prediction: For frozen composition and photon moments, both selected branches plus common UV are affine in T and admit a positive exponential relaxation for nonnegative physical coefficients.
hypotheses.falsifier: A nonzero symbolic solution residual, incorrect initial value, wrong equilibrium/decay sign, or a physically admitted coefficient giving negative A or B.

hypotheses.prediction: The abundance derivative is finite at zero electron fraction without division by x_e; normalized coordinate scaling is the only additional chain-rule factor.
hypotheses.falsifier: A nonzero symbolic difference from direct quotient differentiation or a singularity at x_e=0 with eta>0.

hypotheses.prediction: The gas, Compton bath, UV bath and escaping-radiation local source ledger cancels identically; the Planck-only FLRW limit matches the established cosmological matter-temperature coupling.
hypotheses.falsifier: A nonzero source sum, a missing particle heat-capacity factor, or incorrect dimensional/sign correspondence in the primary equation.

methods.method: Read the active contract, immutable thermal row, prior Compton moment source and coordinate/H-gradient owners; derive the added row only.

One targeted Exa search and one targeted SciSpace search for primary cosmological gas Compton thermal-coupling equations; retrieve only the selected primary pages needed to verify coefficient/conventions.
Actual Wolfram Language evaluation of branch identities, 63-row structural derivatives, frozen-coefficient solution and local ledger; retain exact submitted code and response.
Map equations, source versions, units and source-code owners into the Korean theory and JSON source record; hand to an artifact-distinct reviewer through the parent.

stopping_rules: Stop P1 after the requested theory, source provenance and actual symbolic receipt are complete and sent to parent; independent review belongs to P4.
No ODE or old-result/test replay; no wholesale literature search.
At most one diagnostic retry of an unchanged failed tool operation; preserve errors and use a distinct supported route when productive.
